    Modules with finitely many predecessors and no cycle are directing #

    PredN U n X: X is reached from U by n steps into summands of chosen minimal right almost split maps. If the predecessors of U have bounded dimension, a nonzero non-bijective map from an indecomposable N into an n-step predecessor makes N isomorphic to an (n + m)-step predecessor with m ≥ 1 (iso_predN_of_hom). Hence if no proper predecessor is isomorphic to U, then U is directing (directing_of_noCycle), so a brick.
